data.title: Building the System/360 Mainframe Nearly Destroyed IBM
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: IBM's System/360 (S/360), introduced in 1964, was a transformative mainframe series that revolutionized computing and business operations, despite nearly destroying IBM during its development. The project cost US$5 billion and involved creating a line of 150 products, including 9-track magnetic tape drives. Before the S/360, IBM's popular 1401 mainframe could not be expanded or upgraded, leading to customer demand for compatible and upgradable systems. Internal rivalry between IBM's Endicott and Poughkeepsie engineering teams further complicated matters, as their systems were incompatible. To stay competitive and reduce R&D costs, IBM decided to develop the S/360, aiming for a unified system that could handle various tasks and grow with customer needs. The development process was chaotic, marked by internal conflicts and technological uncertainties, but ultimately succeeded, changing the course of computing history. The S/360's success cemented IBM's leadership and enabled the widespread adoption of computers in the Information Age.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：IBM System/360 系统的开发、影响及其历史背景

不同观点：
• Herodotus 强调了 IBM 360 系统开发中，决定 32 位是否足够表示“大多数”浮点数的系统性过程，通过查阅期刊并咨询专家，显示出开发的严谨性。
• Froh 指出不仅软件开发混乱，硬件开发也几乎失败，并提及 IBM 后期通过技术改进和企业 Linux 的引入两次挽救了公司。
• Talkingtab 分享了个人经历，描述了 IBM 360 在实际使用中遇到的速度和效率问题，以及苹果电脑的出现如何改变了他们的工作方式，并提出当前高端智能手机与 IBM 360 计算能力的对比。
• BXLE_1-1-BitIs1 讨论了 z 系列主机的虚拟化技术，包括 z/VM 和 LPAR 的使用，并提到早期 S/360 安装和 SIE 指令的出现。
• EncomLab 引用了 Alan Kay 的观点，强调计算机科学领域对历史贡献的忽视，并对文章表示赞赏。

补充讨论：
• Noworld 提供了 IBM 大型机的最新资料链接，指出其目前仍活跃。
• SoftTalker 解释了磁带驱动器高柜的设计目的，即为了加速磁带的读写操作。
• ChicagoDave 分享了 IBM 自己开发电子表格应用以应对 Lotus 授权压力的故事。
• Shrubble 补充了关于 IBM 360 项目初期的财务和管理问题，包括高额成本和库存管理混乱。
• Emchammer 提到了一个关于办公室引入计算机的文化反应的电视剧情。
• JJMcJ 指出《The Mythical Man Month》一书大量基于作者在 System/360 项目中的经验，讨论了项目中的问题。
• Kwanbix 对 IBM 从创新公司转变为咨询公司表示遗憾。
• Synaesthesia 强调了 IBM 360 时代尚未使用集成电路的技术背景，并提供了相关资料链接。
• Cafard 提到 Thomas Watson, Jr. 的书《A Business and Its Beliefs》未提及 S/360 工作，并指出其今日阅读的特殊意义。

争议焦点：IBM 360 项目在硬件和软件开发中的复杂性与挑战，以及 IBM 作为技术创新公司的历史演变。

43619229.article_content:
History of Technology
Feature
Building the System/360 Mainframe Nearly Destroyed IBM
Instead, the S/360 proved to be the most successful product launch ever and changed the course of computing
James W. Cortada
05 Apr 2019
15 min read
IBM spent US $5 billion to build the System/360, introduced in 1964. These 9-track magnetic tape drives were among the S/360’s 150-product line.
Photo: Mark Richards/Computer History Museum
A short list of the most transformative products
of the past century and a half would include the lightbulb, Ford’s Model T—and the
IBM System/360
. This
mainframe
series forever changed the computer industry and revolutionized how businesses and governments worked, enhancing productivity and making countless new tasks possible.
In the years leading up to its 7 April 1964 launch, however, the 360 was one of the scariest dramas in American business. It took a nearly fanatical commitment at all levels of
IBM
to bring forth this remarkable collection of machines and software. While the technological innovations that went into the S/360 were important, how they were created and deployed bordered on disaster. The company experienced what
science policy expert Keith Pavitt called “tribal warfare”
: people clashing and collaborating in a rapidly growing company with unstable, and in some instances unknown, technologies, as uncertainty and ambiguity dogged all the protagonists.
Ultimately,
IBM
was big and diverse enough in talent, staffing, financing, and materiel to succeed. In an almost entrepreneurial fashion, it took advantage of emerging technologies, no matter where they were located within the enterprise. In hindsight, it seemed a sloppy and ill-advised endeavor, chaotic in execution and yet brilliantly successful. We live in an age that celebrates innovation, so examining cases of how innovation is done can only illuminate our understanding of the process.
By the end of the 1950s,
computer users faced a seemingly intractable problem. Had it not been solved, it would have prevented computers from becoming widespread, and any thoughts of living in an Information Age would have been fiction.
The S/360 was designed to replace IBM’s 1401 mainframe, which was popular but couldn’t be expanded or upgraded.
Photo: IBM
Organizations were acquiring computers in great numbers, automating many of the old punch card operations and doing more with data processing. The popularity of the IBM 1401 illustrates the rapid adoption of computing. Over 12,000 of these systems were sold from their introduction in 1959 to 1971, when IBM retired the line.
With the 1401 so dominating the computer business, any problems with it were serious. One of them was that the 1401 was too small.
Users found these machines so useful that they kept piling more work on them, reaching the system’s capacity. They then had three options: move to a bigger IBM system, such as an IBM 7000, install a competitor’s system, or acquire more 1401s. None of these options was attractive. To change to a bigger system required rewriting software, since the old software would not work on a different type of machine. The cost of rewriting could easily exceed the financial benefits of moving to a bigger machine. Such a change also called for retraining staff or hiring new staff familiar with the new system. Adding more units of the same system was equally unattractive because each unit required duplicate staff, equipment, and maintenance of hardware and software. Customers wanted systems that were “upgradable” or “compatible,” such that as their needs grew, they could bring in larger machines but still run the same software and peripheral equipment. In the 1950s and early 1960s, it was a wish, and for vendors an aspiration.
IBM had worse problems than its customers did. The 1401s were proving so popular that engineers in Endicott, N.Y., which had developed the system, resisted attempts by their counterparts in Poughkeepsie to build larger computers, leading to growing rivalry between the two groups. As one engineer recalled, “So intense was it that sometimes it seemed to exceed the rivalry with external competitors.” Systems made by Poughkeepsie would not run programs written for the 1400 series. Customers wanting to move from the smaller 1400s to the larger Poughkeepsie machines put increasing pressure on IBM to provide compatibility. Senior management had to contend with the expenses of sustaining R&D for a half-dozen incompatible product lines and training IBMers to sell and maintain so many systems.
Consensus grew that IBM needed to get down to one system to simplify production, reduce the cost of R&D, and be more competitive against a growing array of rivals. If customers had to upgrade in the early 1960s, they could just as easily move to a competitor’s machine, since they would have to rewrite their software anyway.
The power of compatibility was demonstrated in the fall of 1960, when IBM introduced the more powerful 1410 to replace the 1401. S

data.title: The Greatest Motorcycle Photo
data.author: keepamovin
data.article_summary: 1948年9月13日，47岁的摩托车手Rollie Free在美国犹他州博纳维尔盐滩上以水平姿势躺在摩托车上，以减少风阻，创下150.313英里每小时的世界摩托车速度记录。他当时骑着一辆Vincent HRD Black Shadow，只穿着泳裤。这一壮举被《LIFE》杂志的摄影师Peter Stackpole拍摄下来，成为摩托车运动史上最著名的照片之一。尽管该记录后来在2010年被打破，但Free的创举和照片至今仍广受欢迎。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：经典摩托车历史照片及其背后的故事

不同观点：
• [dogman1050] 认为展示的图片是他最喜欢的摩托车历史图片，展示了1907年Peking to Paris比赛中的车辆和团队。他提到团队虽然没有赢得比赛，但付出了极大努力，并引用了Motor-journalist Denis Jenkinson的相似经历作为例子。[1][2][3]
• [nathan_compton] 不同意，认为Emile Leray在沙漠中将坏车改装成摩托车的照片更好，并提供了相关链接以展示此故事。[4]
• [HPsquared] 幽默地评论了图片中人物对后挡泥板的信任。
• [skeptrune] 认为图片完美捕捉了美国摩托文化的氛围，并对图片中人物的年龄感到惊讶。
• [WillAdams] 提到了一首关于摩托车的歌曲，并认为这首歌可能是最伟大的摩托车歌曲，同时赞赏摩托车的工程奇迹。

补充讨论：
• [omoikane] 对摄影师能在摩托车以150英里每小时的速度下捕捉到完美对焦的图片表示钦佩。
• [linsomniac] 表达了对图片的欣赏，但也分享了因女儿“初恋”在摩托车事故中去世的个人悲剧，提醒大家注意安全。
• [ChuckMcM] 认为图片启发了Burt Monroe在1967年破纪录的举动，并提到电影《The World's Fastest Indian》，同时对工程 ingenuity和风险表示思考。
• [AdieuToLogic] 提到了“heel clicker in a supercross race”的难度和风险，认为这也是值得考虑的经典摩托车时刻。[0]
• [ftbsqcfjm] 对摄影技术表示赞赏，认为图片体现了摩托车运动先驱的无畏精神，是经得起时间考验的标志性图像。
• [signa11] 联想到电影《The World's Fastest Indian》及Burt Munro的生活，认为其非常了不起，并推荐了相关链接。[5][6]
• [hinkley] 提到在某些年，人们在专业自行车下坡比赛中尝试类似举动，直到被禁止，因为这种情况下控制力很差。
• [cromulent] 则认为Evel Knievel在Caesers Palace喷泉上高高跃起的照片更为经典，认为其为许多极限运动的起源。
• [brucehoult] 对Burt Munro的性格表示惊讶。
• [drcongo] 对有人在仅仅穿着内衣的情况下完成摩托壮举感到震惊。

争议焦点：
• 不同用户对于哪张摩托车历史图片最为经典存在分歧，如[dogman1050]和[nathan_compton]的不同意见。
• 对摩托车历史事件中的风险与成就的价值判断存在思考，如[ChuckMcM]和[ftbsqcfjm]的讨论。

Gallery Of
The Greatest Motorcycle Photo Ever
Rollie Free getting ready to break the motorcycle speed record on the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, 1948.
Peter Stackpole/Life Picture Collection/Shutterstock
SEE DETAILS
Rollie Free, laying horizontally on his bike to reduce wind resistance, broke the world’s speed record for a motorcycle at the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, September 13, 1948.
eter Stackpole/Life Picture Collection/Shutterstock
Not only did
Rollie Free
set the world speed record for a motorcycle back in 1948—he looked darn good doing it.
The key to setting the record for Free was cutting down on wind resistance. So when the 47-year-old accelerated his
Vincent HRD Black Shadow
, he positioned his body to be as horizontal as it could. Also, he wore only swim trunks as he whipped across the hard pack of the
Bonneville Salt Flats
. His plan worked to perfection, setting a record of 150.313 miles per hour.
The
AMA Motorcycle Hall of Fame
calls the picture of Free’s record-setting ride “one of the most famous photos in the history of the sport.” LIFE staff photographer Peter Stackpole’s image of Free is also
one of the most popular prints in the LIFE photo store
.
In
LIFE’s coverage of the event
the magazine actually used a different photo, taken from a wider angle. That shot is majestic in its own right, giving more emphasis to the Utah landscape and also the black line that had been painted on the ground for Free to use as a guide.
All the shots in this gallery have their charm. The ones of Free’s friends giving him a push as he started out are pretty classic. The details in Stackpole’s photos are evocative of their era, from Free’s everyman physique to the media coverage of the speed record being dominated by still photography.
Free’s record has long since been broken. The current mark of 376.363 miles per hour was set in 2010 by Rocky Robinson—once again in Bonneville. While in 1948 Free rode a conventional-looking motorcycle,
Robinson set his mark in a vehicle that looks more like a two-wheeled car
, down to its encased cockpit. This meant that Robinson had no need to strip down to a bathing suit and position his body at an exotic angle, or do anything else that would result in a photo for the ages.

• 一些评论提到Frank Lloyd Wright的官方组织（如Frank Lloyd Wright基金会和Frank Lloyd Wright建筑保护委员会）对某些建筑项目持反对态度。这种反对可能导致这些项目无法使用基金会的档案材料和照片，影响出版物的发布。（brudgers）
• 有人关注Wright的Usonian住宅的结构问题，特别是与Fallingwater相关的结构工程缺陷，以及当前所需的重大结构升级。这引发了对Wright设计中结构安全性的讨论。（Animats）
• 另一观点指出，Wright的设计在实际建造过程中往往需要修改，且Wright在世时会通过照片来认证建筑。有评论猜测，基金会的反对可能源于对法律诉讼的担忧。（wnissen）
• 一些评论简单表达了对Wright设计的欣赏，提到其美学价值和独特性，同时有人指出Usonian设计在现代仍有建造实例。（jmclnx, Pxtl）
• 有人对编辑错误（如将两卧室房屋误写为三卧室）提出批评，认为这是不应该发生的低级错误。（dylan604）
• 一种批评观点认为Wright的建筑设计虽然美丽但不适合居住，强调其设计理念可能过于理想化，不适合实际生活需求。（nothercastle, Pxtl）

补充讨论：
• 有评论对Usonian一词的词源进行了探讨，指出其可能来源于James Duff Law，并提供了相关参考链接。（defrost）
• 有人对该话题被标记为有争议表示不解，认为该讨论内容并不具争议性或煽动性。（jamincan）
• 对于Wright设计的实用性和美学价值，存在对立观点。有人欣赏其设计的独特和美丽，而另一些人则批评其不适合实际居住和生活需求。（Pxtl, nothercastle）

总体来看，讨论围绕Wright建筑设计的审美价值、结构安全性和实际居住适用性展开，同时涉及官方组织的态度和编辑问题等细节。

data.title: Solving a “Layton Puzzle” with Prolog
data.author: Tomte
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了作者在重写《逻辑编程语言》章节时，计划用更实用的例子替代经典的逻辑谜题演示，如八皇后问题和四色问题。作者提到，虽然展示谜题解法在时事通讯中很酷，但他希望例子更具实用性。接着，他讨论了使用Prolog解决一个电子游戏谜题，该谜题涉及根据给定学生的得分推断出第四个学生的答案。

作者详细解释了Prolog代码，展示了如何定义评分规则，并利用递归计算学生的得分。Prolog的逻辑谓词具有双向性，不仅可以验证得分，还能推导可能的答案。最后，作者改进了程序，确保答案键的长度和元素类型符合要求。整个过程展示了Prolog在解决逻辑问题上的强大功能和灵活性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同方法解决逻辑谜题的可行性及优缺点，特别是使用Prolog及其他工具如Z3、约束满足问题（CSP）等。

不同观点：
• **tannhaeuser**：认为文章使用SWI Prolog的约束库解决谜题是多余的，因为问题可以通过纯ISO Prolog轻松解决，并提供了Pablo的解决方案链接。强调了直接执行Prolog代码的简便性。
• **taeric**：对谜题表示兴趣，并提到Knuth关于约束满足的讨论。建议将实际问题与儿童谜题类比，以增加趣味性，鼓励更多类似讨论。
• **a_e_k**：展示了使用Z3Py（一个SAT求解器）的解决方案，以简洁的代码实现了问题求解，并承认自己并非Z3专家，可能有更优解法。
• **NooneAtAll3**：提供了一种“人工”解法，通过逻辑推理和代数方程逐步推导出谜题答案，展示了不依赖编程工具的解题思路。
• **Avshalom**：分享了另一种Prolog解决方案，指出在不同Prolog环境（如Ciao Prolog）中需要加载额外模块。也提供了代码示例。
• **crtasm**：简单提到谜题来源于《雷顿教授》游戏系列，未深入讨论解法。
• **AceJohnny2**：引用了Hacker News上关于Prolog为何失去流行的讨论，并通过个人经历说明了Prolog在解决某些逻辑谜题上的有效性。
• **jodrellblank**：提供了可以在SWISH（SWI Prolog在线环境）中运行的Prolog代码，展示了如何利用约束求解器解决谜题，并给出了具体操作步骤。
• **trainyperson**：建议通过“纸笔”逻辑推理解决谜题，认为无需依赖约束求解工具，强调了逻辑推理过程的趣味性和可操作性。
• **jfengel**：认为谜题可以通过暴力求解，但对新手来说可能过于复杂。询问是否存在纯演绎的解法，以减少试错空间。
• **superlopuh**：分享了使用Sentient语言解决类似谜题的经历，认为其比Prolog更符合人体工程学，但Sentient项目已多年未更新，表示遗憾。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是使用Prolog的约束库是否必要，tannhaeuser认为纯Prolog即可解决问题，而其他人如jodrellblank和Avshalom则展示了使用约束库的解决方案。
• 不同工具和方法的优缺点被讨论，如Z3Py和Prolog的对比，以及人工推理与自动化工具的取舍。
• 对新手友好性的考虑也被提及，trainyperson和jfengel都关注了谜题对新手的难度问题，并提出了不同的简化解决方案。
• 一些评论提到了相关资源和外部讨论，如Knuth的书和Hacker News上的讨论，扩展了话题的范围。

I have a lot in the works for the this month's

data.title: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search: Fast When Done Right (Debunking the Slow Myth)
data.author: VoVAllen
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Postgres 全文搜索（FTS）的性能、优化及其与其他搜索系统（如Elasticsearch）的对比

不同观点：
• **[retakeming]**：作为pg_search的维护者，认为Postgres文档中同时认可多种优化策略。pg_search的目的是解决如何让Postgres在各种复杂查询（如布尔、模糊、分面、相关性排序等）上达到Elasticsearch级别的性能，而不是针对单一查询的优化。Neon/ParadeDB的基准测试包含12个查询，虽然可以通过创建复合索引等方法优化，但这些方法在实际应用中不现实。pg_search提供了一种简单的索引定义，无需用户对每个文本列进行重复操作。

• **[danpalmer]**：批评了Neon/ParadeDB文章中的基准测试方法，认为其错误在于动态计算tsvector，而Postgres文档中已经明确说明了如何优化查询性能。他认为这种错误要么是故意误导，要么是由于没有仔细阅读文档。

• **[nattaylor]**：关注查询计划（explain plans），提到如果查询使用了索引，那么动态重新检查tsvector只会在匹配项上进行，且由于查询限制了返回10条数据，因此重新检查的数量有限。但如果查询在两个GIN索引上有条件，则可能导致不必要的工作。

• **[nostrebored]**：质疑为什么人们希望把所有功能（如向量搜索、全文搜索、工作负载编排、队列等）都放入Postgres中，不理解这种趋势。

• **[zhousun]**：支持更多“Postgres原生”的全文搜索实现，认为像Lucene/Tantivy这样的解决方案由于设计初衷不同，与Postgres的堆表结合时效果不佳。

• **[some_developer]**：分享了多年前尝试使用Postgres原生FTS失败的经历，由于在插入频繁的表上添加索引导致事务超时，最终不得不放弃。

• **[atemerev]**：认为1000万条记录是一个玩具数据集，建议使用更大的数据集（如完整的维基百科或Reddit评论）来进行基准测试以获得更有意义的比较。

• **[ltbarcly3]**：认为Postgres全文搜索过于僵化，无法进行复杂调优，如子字符串搜索、自定义分词等，而Solr和Elasticsearch在这方面提供了更强的配置能力。Postgres的FTS系统被视为一个简单的玩具系统，无法满足复杂需求。

补充讨论：

data.author: 1ilit
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源数据库迁移/转换工具的商业化、功能改进及社区反馈

不同观点：
• 支持商业化：有评论指出该工具具备商业化潜力，可以提供付费支持、高级功能（如团队协作、更多数据库支持等），并且不会影响免费版本的继续使用。这种做法能带来可观的收入，且许多公司愿意为支持服务付费。
• 反对商业化：部分评论认为并非所有项目都需要商业化，维护和运营一个企业需要大量精力，可能导致失去对项目的热情。同时，社区支持和项目的成功本身已经是很有价值的成就。
• 商业化建议：建议通过提供高级功能（如桌面客户端、数据库视图和存储过程支持等）来实现商业化，同时保留核心工具的免费使用，以吸引更多用户。

补充讨论：
• 法律结构：建议建立合法的商业结构以保护产品权益，并为未来可能的出售或融资做好准备。
• 社区反馈：当前社区的贡献是项目的重要资产，建议制定短期和长期的产品路线图，并与社区分享，以获得持续的反馈和支持。
• 功能改进建议：
  - 调整网格间距和大小、增加对齐网格选项、侧边栏宽度自定义等UI改进。
  - 增加对视图和复杂数据库结构的支持。
  - 考虑引入自动布局和命令行辅助编辑等功能。
• 竞争对手：提到需要与Supabase等具有AI集成的开源工具竞争，建议研究其代码以寻找改进机会。
• 移动端支持：有用户询问是否会增加移动布局支持。
• 技术术语：对“retro”一词的含义存在疑问，建议使用更明确的表达如“retrospective”。

争议焦点：
• 商业化路径的分歧：一方认为商业化可以为项目带来更多资源和可持续发展，另一方则担心这会影响项目的初衷和社区的积极性。
• 功能扩展与核心体验的平衡：如何在不失去核心用户的情况下，增加高级功能以实现商业化，同时满足免费用户的需求。

总结：评论中既有对工具商业化潜力的看好，也有对社区和免费使用模式的坚持，功能改进和竞争分析也是讨论的重要内容。

data.title: Linux Kernel Defence Map – Security Hardening Concepts
data.author: transpute
data.article_summary: Linux Kernel Defence Map 是一个展示 Linux 内核中漏洞类别、利用技术、错误检测机制和防御技术之间关系的图形化工具。该地图不代表完全缓解，而是展示各概念间的关联，帮助开发者浏览内核文档和源码。它包含常见弱点枚举（CWE）编号，并聚焦于内核加固，不涵盖用户空间安全特性或Linux安全模块（LSM）策略。该项目在 GitHub 等平台上开源，使用 DOT 语言编写，并通过 GraphViz 生成 SVG 图，许可证为 GPL-3.0。此外，作者还创建了 kernel-hardening-checker 工具，用于检查内核配置的安全加固选项。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕内核安全加固工具及其相关话题的讨论

不同观点：
• [anthonyryan1] 认为 kernel-hardening-checker 工具非常有用，能够帮助分析个人内核配置文件并指出安全改进的地方。他还提到该工具比 KSPP 更全面，但有时建议过于激进，可能会建议禁用一些用户正在使用的内核功能。
• [nine_k] 对工具中防御机制的数量表示赞赏，尤其是对一些商业防御机制的涵盖。不过他认为针对 C 语言特定问题（如未定义行为、边界检查、使用后释放等）的关注相对较少，并提出与 OpenBSD 进行对比的兴趣。
• [acje] 对当前处理系统级漏洞分类的模型表示赞赏，但同时认为目前在 von Neumann 架构上扩展的策略存在问题，导致软件分区脆弱、共享内存通信效率低且不可控。他提供了一个详细分析的链接。

补充讨论：
• [hart_russell] 提出了一个实际操作问题，询问在内核更新后，这些安全设置是否会在 Ubuntu 服务器上保持不变。
• [Sponge5] 解释了为什么内核安全加固图中没有包含 SECCOMP，指出该图主要描述内核安全加固，不包括削减攻击面的内容。
• [chenhoey1211] 认为该工具的概念图非常扎实，不仅对内核开发者有用，对使用 Rust、Zig 或其他低级系统代码的开发者也有帮助。他还询问了是否有类似的关于 Wasm 运行时的可视化分解，特别是围绕沙盒和隔离模型的内容。

争议焦点：
• [acje] 对当前系统安全策略的基础架构扩展方向提出质疑，认为 von Neumann 架构扩展策略存在根本性问题，可能导致软件分区脆弱和共享内存问题。

总结：讨论围绕内核安全加固工具的功能、实用性及其在不同系统中的应用展开，同时涉及了对系统架构的深层次思考和具体操作问题的解答。

Linux Kernel Defence Map
Linux kernel security is a very complex topic.
There are many concepts that have interesting relationships with each other:
Vulnerability classes
Exploitation techniques
Bug detection mechanisms
Defence technologies
Some defence technologies are provided by the Linux kernel mainline.
Others are going out‑of‑tree for various reasons (some of them are commercial, for example).
Moreover, there are kernel defences that depend on special hardware features.
It would be convenient to have a graphical representation of Linux kernel security.
That's why I have created a
Linux Kernel Defence Map
showing the relationships between all these concepts.
The node connections don't mean "full mitigation." Rather, each connection represents some kind of relationship.
So the Linux Kernel Defence Map should help to navigate the documentation and Linux kernel sources.
It also provides the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) numbers for vulnerability classes.
This map describes kernel security hardening. It doesn't cover cutting attack surface, userspace security features
and policies enforced by various Linux Security Modules (LSM).
Repositories
At GitHub
https://github.com/a13xp0p0v/linux-kernel-defence-map
At Codeberg:
https://codeberg.org/a13xp0p0v/linux-kernel-defence-map
(go there if something goes wrong with GitHub)
At GitFlic:
https://gitflic.ru/project/a13xp0p0v/linux-kernel-defence-map
How this Map is made
This map is written in the DOT language, which makes maintenance and updating in Git very convenient.
License: GPL-3.0.
The diagram is generated using GraphViz with the following command:
dot -Tsvg linux-kernel-defence-map.dot -o linux-kernel-defence-map.svg
Do you want to check your kernel configuration?
So there are plenty of security hardening options in the Linux kernel. A lot of them are
not enabled by the major distros. We have to configure these options ourselves to
make our systems more secure.
But nobody likes verifying configs manually. So I've created the
kernel-hardening-checker
that checks security hardening options of the Linux kernel.
You are welcome to try it.

data.title: Dockerfmt: A Dockerfile Formatter
data.author: spicypete
data.article_summary: `dockerfmt` 是一个现代化的 Dockerfile 格式化工具和解析器，基于 BuildKit 内部解析器构建。它提供命令行工具，用于检查和格式化 Dockerfile，支持设置缩进、添加尾部新行等。目前不支持 RUN 命令中的分号和组命令，也不处理长 JSON 命令的换行。该工具使用 `mvdan/sh` 格式化 Shell 命令，并支持简单的 heredocs 和内联注释。JS 绑定可在 `js` 目录中找到。该项目遵循 MIT 许可，用户可以通过 GitHub 贡献代码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Dockerfile 的格式化、工具支持、多阶段构建及替代工具

不同观点：
• [grandempire] 认为一个真正的软件工程项目应该有大量的配置文件（dot files）来支持格式化、包管理、代码检查和持续集成，并质疑谁来格式化这些配置文件，暗示项目复杂度高且维护困难。
• [jensenbox] 对源代码中没有 Dockerfile 表示失望，认为 Dockerfile 的缺失使得试用项目变得困难，尤其希望通过 Docker 容器运行项目。
• [urxvtcd] 和 [nikeee] 支持在多阶段 Dockerfile 中通过缩进使结构更清晰，认为不这样做就像其他语言中不缩进函数体一样不合理。

dockerfmt
Dockerfile format and parser, and a modern version of
dockfmt
. Built on top of the internal
buildkit
parser.
Installation
Binaries are available from the
releases
page.
Usage
A updated version of the dockfmt. Uses the dockerfile parser from moby/buildkit and the shell formatter from mvdan/sh.
Usage:
dockerfmt [Dockerfile] [flags]
dockerfmt [command]
Available Commands:
completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
help        Help about any command
version     Print the version number of dockerfmt
Flags:
-c, --check         Check if the file(s) are formatted
-h, --help          help for dockerfmt
-i, --indent uint   Number of spaces to use for indentation (default 4)
-n, --newline       End the file with a trailing newline
-w, --write         Write the formatted output back to the file(s)
Use "dockerfmt [command] --help" for more information about a command.
Limitations
The
RUN
parser currently doesn't support grouping or semicolons in commands
No line wrapping is performed for long JSON commands
The
# escape=X
directive is not supported
Contributions are welcome!
Features
Format
RUN
steps with
https://github.com/mvdan/sh
Support for basic heredocs:
RUN
<<EOF
echo
"hello"
echo
"world"
EOF
Support for basic inline comments in run steps:
RUN
echo
"hello"
\
#
this is a comment
&& echo
"world"
RUN
echo
"hello"
\
#
this is a comment
#
that spans multiple lines
&& echo
"world"
This is surprisingly
non-trivial
as we want to attach the comments to their position in the formatted output, but they are stripped by the parser beforehand.
JS Bindings
The JS bindings are available in the
js
directory. More information on how to use them can be found in the
README
file.

43628037.article_summary: `dockerfmt` 是一个现代化的 Dockerfile 格式化工具和解析器，基于 BuildKit 内部解析器构建。它提供命令行工具，用于检查和格式化 Dockerfile，支持设置缩进、添加尾部新行等。目前不支持 RUN 命令中的分号和组命令，也不处理长 JSON 命令的换行。该工具使用 `mvdan/sh` 格式化 Shell 命令，并支持简单的 heredocs 和内联注释。JS 绑定可在 `js` 目录中找到。该项目遵循 MIT 许可，用户可以通过 GitHub 贡献代码。

data.author: todsacerdoti

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GUI工具包的设计、选择以及对现有工具（如GTK、Qt）的评价

不同观点：
• [nine_k] 认为，专注于Xlib且使用Common Lisp编写的GUI工具包（如Barium）因为不考虑兼容性问题，可以更精简高效。同时，对GTK模仿苹果将 scrollbars 隐藏的设计选择表示不满。
• [zombot] 反对被局限于某种特定的生态系统（暗指Gnome/GTK），并认为这种限制代价高昂。
• [rtpg] 认为Qt/KDE在避免Gnome/GTK相关问题上表现更好，但承认Qt本身也比较"笨重"。
• [userbinator] 提到GUI框架的快速变化（churn）迫使开发者不断修改旧代码，并认为Win32 (+WINE) 是一个更稳定的GUI API选择。
• [nsm] 推荐Racket语言的GUI实现，认为其成熟且跨平台，尤其是与GTK集成良好，适用于教学IDE等场景。
• [boxed] 认为NeXTStep仍然领先于大多数现代GUI框架。
• [01HNNWZ0MV43FF] 对重新发明GUI框架表示兴趣，但认为使用非LISP语言绑定到Barium的实际应用可能性不大。
• [jeffbee] 不理解为什么从GTK2迁移到GTK3会被视为灾难，并质疑为何开发者必须被迫跟随这种"变化"。
• [DeathArrow] 认为使用现有GUI框架（如GTK、Qt等）进行开发困难且容易出错，不具备未来可持续性，因此有人选择自己开发工具包，但这往往是出于实验或乐趣。
• [snvzz] 对Barium这样的新工具包表示支持，希望其能够持久发展，而非像其他流行工具包那样迅速膨胀和消亡。
• [duskwuff] 解释GTK等工具包随时间演变的原因，指出Linux桌面环境的变化导致UI库也需要适应新的硬件和需求，认为期望UI库20多年不变是不现实的。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于开发者是否应被"强迫"跟随GUI框架的演变（如GTK2到GTK3的迁移），以及现有框架如GTK和Qt的优缺点。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是不同开发者对稳定性和新颖性的不同追求，一些开发者倾向于选择老旧但稳定的API（如Win32），而另一些开发者则寻求创新和实验性技术（如Barium、Racket）。
• 对图形和单位标注的正确性也有一个小讨论，[yohbho] 指出学术论文中常见的标注错误，反映出对细节的关注。

data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个由公民科学家Marb自制的实验反应器，利用Birkeland-Eyde过程通过电弧将空气中的氮转化为硝酸。该过程曾在化肥生产中使用，但由于高能耗在一百年前被淘汰。Marb主要出于对科学的兴趣，使用Arduino UNO Rev3控制反应器，通过 breakout shield 调节电弧电源，并使用传感器监控反应条件。尽管该过程效率不高，Marb的设计重点在于空气干燥和电弧控制。他展示了一次实验演示，并表示如果有足够兴趣，会制作更详细的 follow-up 视频。

不同观点：
• **ashoeafoot** 认为是否有必要使用长弧来生成表面，并建议是否可以采用分形表面来实现弧形和隔离效果，可能在质疑当前方法的复杂性或效率。

This DIY experimental reactor harnesses the Birkeland-Eyde process
Arduino Team
—
March 17th, 2025
Nitrogen is critical for farming at scale and without some form of nitrogen to enrich the soil, we couldn’t grow staple crops efficiently enough to feed our large global population. Serious science goes into the production of fertilizers and the Birkeland-Eyde process was one early example. It uses electrical arcs to turn nitrogen in the air into nitric acid. Marb is an enthusiastic citizen scientist and built his own experimental reactor to harness the Birkeland-Eyde process.
The Birkeland-Eyde process was largely phased out a century ago, because it is inefficient due to the high energy requirements. It needs a lot of energy to create the electric arcs — too much energy to be practical at the scale necessary for modern industrial farming. But efficiency isn’t a major concern for Marb, who is more interested in the science than fertilizer production.
Creating an electrical arc isn’t very difficult, but controlling it is more challenging. For that reason, Marb used an
Arduino UNO Rev3
to oversee his DIY reactor. Through a breakout shield, the Arduino controls the flow of power to the arc electrodes. That requires a large power supply, transformers, and a boost converter.
The rest of the reactor is devoted to the containment, preparation, and flow of air. The Birkeland-Eyde process works best with dry air, so Marb’s design pumps air through a desiccant-packed tube and into the reaction chamber where the electrodes meet. Sensors, like a temperature sensor, help the Arduino gain feedback on the conditions.
Marb’s video ends with a demonstration, but he hasn’t yet refined the reaction process for maximum yields. If there is enough interest, Marb says that he’ll make a follow-up video with more detail.

data.title: The order of files in your ext4 filesystem does not matter
data.author: thewisenerd
data.article_summary:
文章主要描述了一次由Node镜像补丁更新引发的生产环境多小时停机事件，根本原因与Bash中的通配符扩展及底层文件系统的变化有关。具体来说，Dockerfile中的`CMD`指令使用通配符`/jars/*`来设置Java类路径，但由于未在bash中运行，JVM自行扩展了通配符。在一个POSIX系统中，这依赖于`readdir`系统调用。由于Node镜像更新改变了底层ext4文件系统的目录哈希种子，导致类路径中JAR文件顺序变化，进而引发应用程序初始化失败。

此外，文章还讨论了其他潜在问题，如`buildah`构建镜像时因未缓存层导致类路径优先级问题，以及对`overlayfs`目录遍历顺序的误解，最终通过聚焦底层文件系统问题找到解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Java类路径中的文件顺序问题及其引发的潜在错误和解决方案

不同观点：
• **userbinator**：认为JVM对通配符的扩展处理是个需要尽快修复的bug，因为类路径的顺序不应影响程序行为。如果顺序确实重要，那就存在潜在问题。
• **wpollock**：指出依赖文件顺序来支持多个jar版本并不是好做法。Java 9引入了多版本jar文件支持，建议使用。同时提出临时解决方案：手动列出特定版本的jar文件，然后再加上通配符参数。
• **yjftsjthsd-h**：提到一个具体案例，客户库依赖Bouncy Castle的特定版本，但由于文件系统顺序的变化导致问题。认为需要一个更确定的文件提供机制。
• **o11c**：指出文件顺序对性能有影响，按照磁盘上的顺序读取文件可以加快I/O速度。
• **jonhohle**：提到构建工具支持重复类检测已有很长时间，忽视这些工具会带来风险。
• **dathinab**：认为如果代码依赖目录迭代的顺序，应该明确排序，因为目录迭代的顺序在不同文件系统上可能不一致。
• **cheshire_cat**：建议通过明确指定类路径而不是使用通配符来避免顺序问题。

• **amelius**：关注"ls"命令在大目录下的性能问题，并提到ext4文件系统在硬链接计数上的限制。

home
the title is a cheeky reference to something at the front page of the
orange site today
1
.
i don’t want to be misleading here; glob order in bash is
“alphanumeric”-ish.
this is more about documenting a wierd bug we encountered recently
after a node image patch update, which in-turn caused a multi-hour
outage since we could not get ahead of it in time.
we have JVM workloads on production, with dockerfiles that look like
this.
CMD ["java", "-cp", "/jars/*", "-server", ..., "com.acmecorp.app.Application"]
the wildcard here, is not a glob, since the thing is not running in a
bash shell. the actual argument value the JVM receives is
"/jars/*"
, and in turn decides to be helpful, and expand
the wildcard anyway
2
.
in posix systems, this happens to use the
readdir
syscall
3
.
tl;dr
overlayfs
delegates
readdir
to the
underlying filesystem
the underlying filesystem happened to be an
ext4
ext4
readdir optimizes by caching the entries of a
directory in a “hashed b-tree” with a specific “directory hash
seed”
the directory hash seed changed with the node image patch update,
causing the jar order in the classpath to change, causing an uncaught
throwable leading to “stuck” application initialization
the rest of the blog is about how i went about trying to figure out
how we got here.
1. red
herring - buildah squashing layers by default
with a recent overhaul a couple years ago of our CI/CD setup (from
Jenkins to GHA), and a couple other reasons, we switched from
docker
to
buildah
for building the container
images, and we noticed that some of the
buildah
built
images would not start up.
we were copying the files into the container image in a specific
order, to possibly save bandwidth with ‘shared’ layers. this involved
copying jars in a specific order of “volatility” (bottom-to-top);
the specific project jars
internal dependencies’ jars
kotlin stdlib, and dependencies’ jars
other dependency jars
the intent was that layers 3 and 4 would “rarely” change, and surely
this should help a bunch with bandwidth given the SHAs would be
consistent.
upon investigation, we identified that a critical configuration file
was being read from a jar that was not “specific project jar”, and this
in-turn was causing the application startup to misbehave.
as an immediate fix, the corresponding fix was made, adding
--layers
to the
buildah bud
step.
“buildah by default does not cache layers during building of the
image, and hence ends up squashing the layers. When using wildcard to
set the classpath for java, the order of listing the jars changes and
hence causes jars other than the project jar to have higher priority in
the class path.
This PR implements usage of the –layers flag , which re-enables
caching of layers and fixes the issues with classpath jar
priorities.”
little did we realize that this didn’t do much; but it seemed to fix
the issue of the configuration file being picked up from the incorrect
jar; and we went our merry way.
2. red herring - overlayfs
layer order
this was an understanding gap, where i had always been under the
impression that a
readdir
over an overlayfs, then the
iteration order would follow the order of the overlayfs directory
stacking order.
sidenote: containers use overlayfs and basically “stack” the
image layers on top of one-another; and they use something called
“white-outs” to handle deletion. one of the reasons why, if there’s a
lot of white-outs, it’s terrible from a perf standpoint, and squashing
layers is supposedly better for performance, or something, idk.
performing the most basic of tests, made me realize this is not the
case. the only guarantee is that an “upper” layer’s files will override
the “lower” layer’s files, but nothing about the iteration order of
overlayfs layers.
this can be easily proven by the following example
uname
-r
# 6.1.0-18-amd64
mkdir
l0 l1 l2 work merged
for
d
in
l0 l1 l2
;
do
for
file
in
$(
seq
10 12
)
;
do
touch
$d
/
$d
-
$file
;
done
;
done
sudo
mount
-t
overlay overlay
-o
lowerdir=./l0:./l1,upperdir=./l2,workdir=./work ./merged/
ls
-1U
./merged/
# list unsorted, basically think readdir
my previous understanding, or at least the understanding as per the
“fix” we put in the previous section, was that the order expected here
is
l2,l1,l0
,
but the actual output, of
ls -1U ./merged/
is,
l1,l2,l0
.
l1-11
l1-10
l1-12
l2-10
l2-12
l2-11
l0-10
l0-12
l0-11
safe to say, while overlayfs guarantees that
upper
directories’ files shall overwrite the
lower
directories
files, it does not guarantee that the directory traversal order shall be
the same way.
around here, I validated that a segment of
ls -1U
on the
merged “overlayfs” folder matched the
ls -1U
order on a
“lower” directory on the underlying ” ext4”, and decided to focus my
efforts on figuring out what was happening there.
3. getting
side-tracked with layer extraction
thinking that the layer extraction logic could’ve changed (why??), i
got to trying to get the exact tar blobs from the image.

getting an auth token f

data.title: A new way to make graphs more accessible to blind and low-vision readers
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: MIT CSAIL开发了Tactile Vega-Lite系统，简化了触觉图表的设计过程，帮助教育者和设计者高效创建无障碍图表。该工具可以将Excel数据自动转换为视觉图表和触觉图表，内置设计标准，简化了以往需要多种软件配合的复杂流程。通过代码编辑器，用户可以自定义标签、刻度等元素，并利用预设的触觉模式快速调整图表。该工具旨在让不具备触觉设计专长的用户也能轻松创建无障碍图表，特别适用于盲人和低视力读者。这项研究将在2025年的人机交互会议上发表。

43595193.article_content:
Breadcrumb
MIT News
A new way to make graphs more accessible to blind and low-vision readers
A new way to make graphs more accessible to blind and low-vision readers
The Tactile Vega-Lite system, developed at MIT CSAIL, streamlines the tactile chart design process; could help educators efficiently create these graphics and aid designers in making precise changes.
Alex Shipps
|
MIT CSAIL
Publication Date
:
March 25, 2025
Press Inquiries
Press Contact
:
Adam
Conner-Simons
Email:
aconner@csail.mit.edu
Phone:
617-324-9135
MIT Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence Lab
Close
Caption
:
The Tactile Vega-Lite system can take data from something like an Excel spreadsheet and turn it into both a standard visual chart and a touch-based one. Design standards are hardwired as default rules within the program, helping educators and designers automatically create accessible tactile charts.
Credits
:
Image: Alex Shipps/MIT CSAIL, with elements from Pixabay.
Previous image
Next image
Bar graphs and other charts provide a simple way to communicate data, but are, by definition, difficult to translate for readers who are blind or low-vision. Designers have developed methods for converting these visuals into “tactile charts,” but guidelines for doing so are extensive (for example, the Braille Authority of North America’s 2022 guidebook is 426 pages long). The process also requires understanding different types of software, as designers often draft their chart in programs like Adobe Illustrator and then translate it into Braille using another application.
Researchers from MIT’s Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) have now developed an approach that streamlines the design process for tactile chart designers. Their program, called “Tactile Vega-Lite,” can take data from something like an Excel spreadsheet and turn it into both a standard visual chart and a touch-based one. Design standards are hardwired as default rules within the program to help educators and designers automatically create accessible tactile charts.
The tool could make it easier for blind and low-vision readers to understand many graphics, such as a bar chart comparing minimum wages across states or a line graph tracking countries’ GDPs over time. To bring your designs to the real world, you can tweak your chart in Tactile Vega-Lite and then send its file to a Braille embosser (which prints text as readable dots).
This spring, the researchers will present Tactile Vega-Lite in a
paper
at the Association of Computing Machinery Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems. According to lead author Mengzhu “Katie” Chen SM ’25, the tool strikes a balance between the precision that design professionals want for editing and the efficiency educators need to create tactile charts quickly.
“We interviewed teachers who wanted to make their lessons accessible to blind and low-vision students, and designers experienced in putting together tactile charts,” says Chen, a recent CSAIL affiliate and master's graduate in electrical engineering and computer science and the Program in System Design and Management. “Since their needs differ, we designed a program that’s easy to use, provides instant feedback when you want to make tweaks, and implements accessibility guidelines.”
Data you can feel
The researchers’ program builds off of their 2017 visualization tool
Vega-Lite
by automatically encoding both a flat, standard chart and a tactile one. Senior author and MIT postdoc Jonathan Zong SM ’20, PhD ’24 points out that the program makes intuitive design decisions so users don’t have to.
“Tactile Vega-Lite has smart defaults to ensure proper spacing, layout, and texture and Braille conversion, following best practices to create good touch-based reading experiences,” says Zong, who is also a fellow at the Berkman Klein Center for Internet and Society at Harvard University and an incoming assistant professor at the University of Colorado. “Building on existing guidelines and our interviews with experts, the goal is for teachers or visual designers without a lot of tactile design expertise to quickly convey data in a clear way for tactile readers to explore and understand.”
Tactile Vega-Lite’s code editor allows users to customize axis labels, tick marks, and other elements. Different features within the chart are represented by abstractions — or summaries of a longer body of code — that can be modified. These shortcuts allow you to write brief phrases that tweak the design of your chart. For example, if you want to change how the bars in your graph are filled out, you could change the code in the “Texture” section from “dottedFill” to “verticalFill” to replace small circles with upward lines.
To understand how these abstractions work, the researchers added a gallery of examples. Each one includes a phrase and what change that code leads to. Still, the team is looking to refine Tactile Vega-Lite’s user interface to make it more accessible to users less

data.author: donnachangstein
data.article_summary: NTATV项目旨在将Windows NT系统（如Windows XP、Windows 2003和ReactOS）移植到初代Apple TV上。经过两年的努力，Windows XP和2003已成功启动至桌面环境，且多项驱动（如PCI、USB、视频、以太网、WiFi、RCA音频等）工作正常，但ReactOS由于HAL问题尚不可用。已知问题包括HDMI音频难以实现、显示待机后需重新插拔HDMI线等。该项目面临的主要挑战是Apple TV仅支持EFI启动，而Windows XP需要传统BIOS。通过自定义加载器，成功绕过限制实现了Windows系统的启动。

NTATV
The NTATV Project: Bringing Windows NT (Windows XP, Windows 2003, ReactOS) to the original Apple TV. Created by DistroHopper39B (YouTube:
@DistrosProjects
, Mastodon:
@distrohopper39b
) with help from several ReactOS devs (see
Credits
)
Want to run this on your Apple TV? Read the
Guide
!
Want to learn how I did this? Read the
Write-Up
!
Status
Windows XP and 2003 are officially bootable on the original Apple TV! After 2 years of work, enough drivers are working to get both OSes to the desktop. However, due to HAL issues, ReactOS is not usable yet. You can get to the desktop, but there is no PCI or USB functionality.

** Audio plays, but at an extremely low volume.
*** Later versions of the driver do not work; see
Guide
Things that will likely never work
HDMI audio
The Apple TV uses an extremely weird configuration for HDMI audio in that the Intel chipset, not the NVIDIA video card, is responsible for the audio over the HDMI port. The Intel HDMI audio drivers from the GMA 950 drivers will install, but no devices show up. In order to get this working, I'd need to completely rewrite the Intel HDMI audio drivers to support the Apple TV, which would likely be extremely complicated. If someone wants to work on this, let me know.
NTVDM
NTVDM on Windows XP requires some legacy BIOS functions (likely the Extended BIOS data area and legacy VGA functions from the GPU) and therefore will not work. Just use DOSBox or
winevdm/otvdm
for old Windows to run DOS/early Windows applications.
Known Issues
With the NVIDIA driver installed, if the display goes into standby, unplugging and re-plugging the HDMI cable is required to get a picture. To avoid this issue, set "Turn off monitor" to "Never" in the Power Options Control Panel.
Component video doesn't work correctly with the NVIDIA driver. Apparently, only the blue component channel is displayed, and attempting to use both HDMI and component video at the same time breaks the system.
When using non-English versions of Windows XP, the FreeLoader NTFS driver fails to read the hard drive after installing drivers. Use FAT32 for non-English Windows. See
#9
.
There is a line of corrupted characters at the bottom the screen at certain resolutions in FreeLoader. This goes away after the Windows kernel begins loading and doesn't affect the desktop.
RDP connections fail for reasons likely related to the NVIDIA driver.
Background
Ever since I saw The 8-Bit Guy's video
"Hacking the Apple TV 1st Generation"
back in 2018 or 2019, I have been fascinated with the original Apple TV. I always wondered if it was possible for it to run Windows XP, but my efforts to actually get it working were kickstarted by
this Michael MJD video
. Pretty quickly afterwards, I got started on hacking my Apple TV, and after over 700 days of on-and-off work, Windows XP finally runs!
Why this was so complicated
While the Apple TV uses a standard x86 CPU and even an IDE hard drive, its firmware is not compatible with standard Windows XP. Windows XP requires legacy BIOS firmware, while the Apple TV is EFI-only. Not only that, the Apple TV's EFI implementation is
weird
- it can only boot one EFI executable, that being the Apple-official boot.efi. However, hackers very quickly realized that the Apple TV does zero verification on the next stage up in the boot process, that being the Mac OS X kernel file. Within three weeks of the Apple TV shipping, Linux was booted through a custom loader that embeds a Linux kernel into a statically linked Mach-O executable, the same type used by the Linux kernel. Using this concept, we can boot, well, anything on the hardware!
However, Windows is much harder to get running on non-standard hardware than Linux. For one, it's proprietary - when the first Linux support for the Apple TV was developed in 2007, installing Linux used to require numerous kernel patches due to Linux's at

data.title: A year of Rust in ClickHouse
data.author: valyala
data.article_summary: 本文总结了ClickHouse项目引入Rust语言的历程和成果。作者Alexey Milovidov表示，ClickHouse核心用C++编写，不会用Rust重写，但为了利用Rust的优势，他们决定允许在新系统组件中使用Rust，并实现与C++代码的互操作。首个Rust组件是BLAKE3哈希函数，随后添加了skim和PRQL等Rust库。其中，PRQL是一种类似SQL的查询语言，现已集成到ClickHouse中，用户可切换查询方言。尽管有些组件后来用C++实现替代，但Rust的引入增强了开发能力，并获得了社区支持。最终，ClickHouse成功实现了Rust与C++的协同工作，为未来更多Rust开发奠定了基础。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust和C++的比较与混合使用

不同观点：
• **[pjmlp]** 认为C++虽然有50年的历史，存在一些缺陷，无法完全达到Rust的安全性，但只要充分利用过去30年来的工具，现状会好很多。他建议在一些安全关键场景下使用Rust，但在其他情况下还需要考虑其他要求，而不仅仅是仿射类型。

• **[epage]** 指出Rust库通常有较大的依赖树，类似于Node.js，需要小心处理依赖爆炸和依赖管理工具（如dependabot）带来的烦恼。他提到在`cargo install`和`cargo add`之间存在紧张关系，并讨论了Rust开发体验中的一些问题和当前的解决方法。

• **[ChocolateGod]** 提到在互联网上讨论C++时，总会有人提到Rust，并认为这种现象是个问题。他还指出，有人在TypeScript选择Go而非Rust时做出了过激反应，认为不应该因为语言选择而攻击他人。

43596419.article_content:
Back
Blog
/
Engineering
A Year of Rust in ClickHouse
Alexey Milovidov
Apr 1, 2025
-
16
minutes read
Rust is a great programming language for terminal applications, fantasy consoles, and web3. If you do an experiment and say "C++" anywhere on the Internet, in a minute someone will chime in and educate you about the existence of Rust. Sadly, ClickHouse is written in C++, not in Rust. If only we had a chance to attract a large army of passionate Rust professionals... So, I decided that we must add Rust to ClickHouse.
The goal was not to rewrite ClickHouse in Rust - this would be a waste of time. We write ClickHouse in C++ and rewrite some parts
from C++ to a better C++
. Rewriting is never an end goal, although I know examples when engineers rewrite code
from Rust in Rust
if they like to rewrite everything in Rust. We should allow writing new system components in Rust. It should be integrated into the build system, so the Rust code interoperates with C++, and it is built and tested together with no complications.
First Steps
#
The first step was to find a small component to kick off the Rust integration. This component should not be in the critical path, it should be something that we can rip off at any time, so if our engineers become too nauseous from Rust poisoning, we just roll it back and forget. At the same time, it should be something large enough to test the integration to the build system. To not risk the mental health of our precious senior C++ developers, I outsourced this task to an undergrad student. To be honest, it's much easier to find Rust experts among undergrad students than inside the company. Rust is prominent in crypto and web3, so the first component to test it was - the integration of the
BLAKE3
hash function into ClickHouse. At that time, BLAKE3 was only implemented in Rust, so it was at least somewhat reasonable.
BLAKE3
#
In a few months, thanks to
Denis Bolonin
, we had
the first code in Rust in ClickHouse
. Rust was added to CMake build scripts using the
"corrosion"
integration; a dedicated directory for Rust code was
added to the project tree
, and we created examples of adding C++ wrappers for Rust libraries. You can read more about this contribution
in the blog post
.
Skim
#
We have made it possible, and we opened floodgates to let the brilliant Rust developers into the ClickHouse codebase! So now they can write something other than new versions of old terminal applications. I was eagerly checking the list of pull requests for the first external contribution by Rust lovers... So they did come! The
first external pull request with Rust
was to improve our terminal application, clickhouse-client, by adding interactive history navigation. Note: before that,
it was already added by calling a subprocess
, but thanks to the integration with Rust, now we build and link this code into the ClickHouse binary. However, the Rust library
has a bug and crashed
.
After adding a second Rust library, skim, we found that the BLAKE3 function is already present in the LLVM's C++ codebase, which we also use. After upgrading LLVM, it was found much simpler to use BLAKE3 from there rather than with a Rust library. And to prove that the Rust integration works and is supported in the CI, it is enough to have only one Rust library. So, we
replaced BLAKE3 from Rust to C++
, and there was no noticeable difference in performance.
PRQL
#
The third library in Rust that we added to ClickHouse was PRQL. It is a query language, an alternative to SQL, which allows expressing queries in a pipelined, composable form. As a downside, it is more syntax-heavy than SQL, reminding something like Clojure. It is popular on the Internet - someone shows PRQL, everyone else thinks "What a wonderful idea, and, also, Rust" and gives this project a star on GitHub. This is, by the way,
how most of Rust projects get their stars on GitHub
. It doesn't look like someone wants to use this language, but what we want is to ride the hype. Another student
selected
the integration of PRQL in ClickHouse as a graduate work.
An example of a SQL query in the ClickHouse dialect:
An example of the same query in PRQL:
After a few months, thanks to
Alexander Nam
, we had
PRQL support merged
into the ClickHouse codebase. ClickHouse has support for switchable dialects. Any time, you can write "SET dialect = 'prql'" or 'kusto', or set it back to 'sql' to switch between different languages. You can specify the dialect in the user's profile, or in the HTTP API's parameter, like any other setting, and pass your queries in the selected dialect. However, there are some downsides of alternative dialects, like the lack of interactive syntax highlighting for all dialects except SQL, and poorer integration with built-in functions and extensions.
Regardless of questions on its usefulness, PRQL brought us better confidence in Rust. After having two Rust libraries in our codebase, we started to understand that it would be hard to get rid of Rust, and we could tol

• bhouston：建议在美国选几个州去除氟化物，进行长期实验，观察对蛀牙和智商等的影响。认为大型实验是解决争议的唯一途径，因为许多群体不接受其他证据。
• derbOac：引用Broadbent等人的研究，认为该研究没有发现氟化物有负面影响，支持氟化物的安全性。
• ggm：提供了一份预印本链接，可能用于支持其对氟化物影响的进一步研究。
• NotGMan：认为氟化物无助于解决蛀牙问题，根本原因在于饮食，尤其是高碳水化合物摄入。反对氟化物是因为其潜在的神经毒素影响，主张通过改变饮食来改善牙齿健康。
• metalman：认为氟化物引发的争论消耗了大量精力，主张公开所有数据以消除疑虑。强调不同人群对氟化物的代谢能力不同，需关注特殊群体。还提到氟化物对牙齿健康的益处最初是在一些有天然氟化物的地区发现的。
• AStonesThrow：幽默地指出茶中也含有氟化物，并认为通过饮茶摄入氟化物是普遍现象。对氟化物的影响持怀疑态度，并暗示可能与个人健康问题有关。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于氟化物对智商和其他健康问题的潜在影响，以及是否应通过去除氟化物进行实验来解决争议。
• 支持氟化物的一方依赖科学研究和历史证据，而反对一方则强调饮食和其他环境因素的影响，并对氟化物的安全性提出质疑。
• 不同观点还涉及氟化物在不同人群中的代谢差异，以及透明公开数据的重要性。
• AStonesThrow的评论提供了一种文化视角，指出茶饮文化中的氟化物摄入现象，为讨论增添了新的维度。

data.title: 'Sun-Like' Stars
data.author: JPLeRouzic
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了“类太阳”恒星的定义及其在科学和媒体中的使用问题。作者自少年时起对环绕类太阳恒星的行星产生兴趣，特别是对半人马座阿尔法是否为类太阳恒星的疑问。随着研究深入，发现该系统包含两到三颗恒星，其轨道稳定性曾被质疑，但后来证实稳定轨道是可能的。作者指出，“类太阳”通常指G类恒星（如太阳），但有些研究将K类甚至F类恒星也包括在内，因为它们也具有较长寿命和稳定性。媒体常模糊使用“类太阳”这一术语，导致混淆。科学文献中对“类太阳”的定义根据具体研究背景有所不同，有时甚至将主序星全部纳入，包括M类红矮星。因此，明确界定“类太阳”恒星对于寻找宜居行星至关重要。

43629887.article_content:
On ‘Sun-like’ Stars
by
Paul Gilster
|
Apr 8, 2025
|
Exoplanetary Science
|
5 comments
The thought of a planet orbiting a Sun-like star began to obsess me as a boy, when I realized how different all the planets in our Solar System were from each other. Clearly there were no civilizations on any planet but our own, at least around the Sun. But if Alpha Centauri had planets, then maybe one of them was more or less where Earth was in relation to its star. Meaning a benign climate, liquid water, and who knew, a flourishing culture of intelligent beings. So ran my thinking as a teenager, but then other questions began to arise.
Was Alpha Centauri Sun-like? Therein hangs a tale. As I began to read astronomy texts and realized how complicated the system was, the picture changed. Two stars and perhaps three, depending on how you viewed Proxima, were on offer here. ‘Sun-like’ seemed to imply a single star with stable orbits around it, but surely two stars as close as Centauri A and B would disrupt any worlds trying to form there. Later we would learn that stable orbits are indeed possible around both of these stars, and in the habitable zone, too (I still get emails from people saying no such orbits are possible, but they’re wrong).
So just how broad is the term ‘Sun-like’? One textbook told me that Centauri A was a Sun-like star, while Centauri B was sometimes described that way, and sometimes not. I thought the confusion would dissipate once I knew enough about astronomical terms, but if you look at scientific papers today, you’ll see that the term is still flexible. The problem is that by the time we move from a paper into the popular press, the term Sun-like begins to lose definition.
Image:
A direct image of a planetary system around a young K-class star, located about 300 light-years away and known as TYC 8998-760-1. The news release describes this as a Sun-like star, raising questions as to how we define the term. Image credit: ESO.
G-class stars are the category into which the Sun fits, with its lifetime on the order of 10 billion years, and if we expand its parameters a bit, we can take in stars around the Sun’s mass – perhaps 0.8 to 1.1 solar masses – and in the same temperature range – 5300 to 6000 K. Strictly speaking, then, Centauri B, which is a K-class star, doesn’t fit the definition of Sun-like, although K stars seem to be good options for habitable worlds. They’re less massive (0.45 to 0.8 solar masses) and cooler (3900 to 5300 K), and they’re more orange than yellow, and they’re longer lived than the Sun, a propitious thought in terms of astrobiology.
So we don’t want to be too doctrinaire in discussing what kind of star a habitable planet might orbit, but we do need to mind our definitions, because I see the term ‘Sun-like’ in so many different contexts. When I see a statement like “one Earth-class planet around every Sun-like star,” I have to ask whether we’re talking about G-class stars or something else. Because some scientists expand ‘Sun-like’ to include not only G- and K- but F-class stars as well. Why do this? Such stars are, like the Sun, long-lived. F stars are hotter and more massive than the Sun, but like G- and K-class stars, they’re stable. Some studies, then, consider ‘Sun-like’ to mean all FGK-type stars.
Some examples. ‘COROT finds exoplanet orbiting Sun-like star’ is the title of a news release that describes a star a bit more massive than the Sun. So the comparison is to G-class stars. ‘Astronomy researchers discover new planet around a ‘Sun-like’ star’ describes a planet around an F-class star, so we are in the FGK realm. ‘First Ever Image of a Multi-Planet System around a Sun-like Star Captured by ESO Telescope’ describes a planet around TYC 8998-760-1, a K-class dwarf.
So there’s method here, but it’s not always clarified as information moves from the academy (and the observatory) into the media. Confounding the picture still further are those papers that use ‘Sun-like’ to mean all stars on the Main Sequence. This takes in the entire range of stars OBAFGKM. This is a rare usage, but there is a certain logic here as well. If you’re looking for habitable planets, it’s clear that stars in the most stable phase of their lives are the ones to examine, burning hydrogen to produce energy. No brown dwarfs here, but the category does take in M-class stars, and the jury is out on whether such stars can support life. And they take in the huge majority of stars in the galaxy.
So if we’re talking about hydrogen burning, the Main Sequence offers up everything from hot blue stars all the way down to cool red dwarfs. End the hydrogen burning and a different phase of stellar evolution begins, producing for example the kind of white dwarf that the Sun will one day become. A paper’s context usually makes it perfectly clear which of the three takes on ‘Sun-like’ it is using, but the need to clarify the term in news releases, particularly when dealing with a wide range through F-, G- and K-class s

data.title: A guide to reduce screen time
data.author: nullderef
data.article_summary:
《如何减少屏幕时间：终极指南》由Mario Ortiz Manero于2025年3月7日撰写。文章探讨了如何在过度使用社交媒体和完全戒断之间找到平衡。首先，理解使用手机的根本原因，如无聊、焦虑或肌肉记忆。改变心态，将焦点从“少用手机”转向“多做其他活动”，并从小目标开始。

工具和内置功能可以帮助减少屏幕时间。iOS的屏幕时间功能和Android的数字健康工具可以分析使用模式、设置应用限制和提醒。高级功能如iOS快捷指令和三星的模式与例程可提供更多自定义选项。

文章还推荐了几款应用程序，如One Sec、Opal和即将推出的SpeedBump，它们通过提醒、数据统计和限制使用时间等方式帮助减少屏幕时间。选择适合自己的工具和方法，逐步实现减少屏幕时间的目标。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何有效减少屏幕时间及应对数字分心

不同观点：
• [ivan_ah] 支持每周设定24小时的“互联网安息日”，通过断开网络连接来减少分心。他强调，问题不在于互联网或应用程序本身，而在于信息流的推送机制让人容易陷入无意识的消耗中。他认为这样能提升效率，并让生活更有意性。
  
• [doright] 认为像TikTok这样的应用程序确实容易让人上瘾，特别是对于有焦虑或无聊倾向的人。他质疑是否有人能真正以健康的心态使用这些应用，而不依赖外部的控制手段。同时指出，过度的屏幕时间限制可能无法解决深层次的焦虑问题。

• [sshkhr] 通过一系列软件工具（如SocialFocus、Cold Turkey等）成功减少了屏幕时间，特别是浪费性的使用时间。他强调技术手段可以有效减少分心，并分享了具体的操作方法，如移除信息流和设定时间限制。

• [master-lincoln] 指出讨论主要集中在手机屏幕时间，但忽略了电脑屏幕时间的问题。他每天因工作需要已经面对屏幕5小时，并认为文章没有考虑到像他这样主要用屏幕工作的人的需求。

• [Zambyte] 采取了更极端的做法，将手机长时间存放，并用一个功能有限的平板替代。他发现这样能显著减少无意识的使用，并提升生活的意性，特别是在应对无聊或尴尬时刻时，不再依赖手机。

• [pseudocomposer] 推荐了ScreenZen等工具来限制屏幕时间，并希望结合其他功能（如SpeedBump）进一步优化。他强调了等待机制在减少应用使用上的有效性。

• [codethief] 寻求Android平台上不卖数据且不请求网络访问的开源屏幕时间限制应用，对Google的Digital Wellbeing在非Google设备上的不可用表示失望。

• [_kush] 强调桌面屏幕时间对健康的影响，特别是对眼睛和姿势的影响。他开发了一款名为LookAway的工具，提醒用户适时休息，并呼吁更多关注桌面使用习惯的管理。

• [n8cpdx] 支持使用iOS的专注模式，并认为这一功能被低估。他指出Android缺乏类似功能，并希望看到改进。同时对iOS的屏幕时间统计功能表示不满。

• [chadhutchins10] 推荐了Brick应用作为有效的应用拦截工具。

• [bcye] 通过仅安装自由软件和不使用浏览器来减少屏幕时间，发现效果显著。

• [cush] 尝试了多种方法后，最终通过删除所有带有算法信息流的应用和Safari浏览器，成功减少了屏幕时间。

• [gchokov] 幽默地建议，生孩子并每天陪伴他们玩耍是减少屏幕时间的有效方法。

• [evrimoztamur] 通过重新开始在纸上涂鸦，成功减少了屏幕时间，并发现这种活动非常有趣且能提升意性。

补充讨论：
- 技术工具（如软件限制、手机功能调整）在减少屏幕时间中的重要性被多次提及。
- 不同用户对屏幕时间的关注点不同，有些人更关注手机使用，有些人则关注电脑使用。
- 有人认为深层次的心理问题（如焦虑）可能需要比单纯限制屏幕时间更复杂的解决方案。
- 有些用户通过替代活动（如户外运动、涂鸦、陪伴孩子）来减少屏幕时间，并取得良好效果。

争议焦点：
- 是否可以通过简单的屏幕时间限制工具来有效减少数字分心，还是需要更深入的心理调整。
- 桌面屏幕时间在讨论中被认为没有得到足够关注，特别是对于需要长时间使用电脑工作的人。

43630661.article_content:
How to Reduce Screen Time: The Ultimate Guide
Written by
Mario Ortiz Manero
on March 7, 2025
This page is also available in:
Deutsch
,
Español
Completely quitting social media is getting less and less realistic. Platforms like Instagram or TikTok can be essential to connect with friends, but it’s easy to get hooked. We’ve all been there: someone shares a Reel, taking you into an hour-long rabbit hole of cats dancing to Shakira. It’s fun, but you feel frustrated and powerless.
Can we find balance between being “chronically online” and becoming a buddhist monk?
It turns out that taking action isn’t that hard. Having spent countless hours as a student and later working, I’ve collected over 40 tips to reduce your screen time.
Understand the Why
#
Start by understanding
why
you use your phone even though you don’t want to:
Boredom
Anxiety
Procrastination
Muscle memory
Spending time on social media is okay! Not just to connect, but also for coping. We’re human, and getting our mind off a problem can relieve stress to tackle it later. In
a study on Twitch livestreams helping people through tough times
, 82% found them at least somewhat helpful.
Having that in mind, we all reach a point where being online is counterproductive. It depends, but deep inside you’ll know when that happens.
Changing your Mindset
#
Most importantly,
change your perspective from “using your phone less” to “doing something else more”
. What would you rather do than scroll on social media? Make a list of 5 items:
Don’t start doing them all at once or build unrealistic expectations. Start with small goals like simply showing up to an activity, and take it from there.
Tools to Cut Down on Screen Time
#
Tools are a useful band-aid while you tackle the root cause. Especially because “tackling the root cause” might be an endless task. The following ideas will add friction to addictive apps, remind you that maybe it’s been too long, and keep you accountable.
Built-in Screen Time Features
#
In case you don’t know it, Android and iOS include powerful features to lower your phone time:
iOS Screen Time
(available since iOS 12):
Open Settings on your iPhone, iPad, or MacBook
Look for “Screen Time”
Features: analyze your usage patterns, set focus time (downtime), add app limits. Advanced features include “always allowed” apps or “screen distance”.
Android Digital Wellbeing
(available since 2018):
Open Settings on your smartphone or tablet
Look for “Digital Wellbeing & Parental Controls”
Features: analyze your usage patterns, set timers for apps, or specify a screen time goal. In my experience, advanced ones like “screen time while walking” or “driving monitor” consume battery but don’t work that well.
Before you continue, use this data to learn how many years of your life will be spent on your phone:
Screen Time Life Calculator
Average daily screen time (hours)

《如何减少屏幕时间：终极指南》由Mario Ortiz Manero于2025年3月7日撰写。文章探讨了如何在过度使用社交媒体和完全戒断之间找到平衡。首先，理解使用手机的根本原因，如无聊、焦虑或肌肉记忆。改变心态，将焦点从“少用手机”转向“多做其他活动”，并从小目标开始。

data.title: Hardening the Firefox Front End with Content Security Policies
data.author: evilpie
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了Firefox用户界面（UI）使用网页技术（如HTML、CSS和JavaScript）的优点和潜在安全风险，尤其是注入攻击（如XSS）。由于Firefox UI运行在父进程中，而网页内容在低权限的子进程中，正常情况下网页内容无法注入到父进程。然而，在Pwn2Own 2022比赛中，有参赛者利用漏洞逃逸出网页内容沙箱，通过在Firefox UI中创建JavaScript inline事件处理器实现攻击。

为防止此类攻击，Firefox团队借鉴网页安全措施，如内容安全策略（CSP），已从`browser.xhtml`中移除了超过600个inline事件处理器，并用`addEventListener`替代。此外，针对其他窗口和侧边栏，添加了更严格的CSP以增强安全性。这些措施显著提升了Firefox前端代码的安全性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：CSP（内容安全策略）的有效性、实现问题以及在浏览器和扩展中的应用

不同观点：
• theandrewbailey：认为CSP在防止安全漏洞方面非常有效，但很多开发者和设计师没有认真对待，不正确地实现CSP（如不使用外部文件设置样式和脚本）。他主张应像反对表格布局一样反对内联样式和脚本。

• davidmurdoch：指出Firefox在扩展中的CSP存在长达9年的未修复bug，并提供了bug链接。他提到Mozilla的扩展商店不允许变通方案，尽管这已被确认为bug。

• lol768：表达了对浏览器DevTools和界面引入与网页相同安全问题的担忧，认为这是从XUL迁移后产生的新问题，类似于Electron中XSS变成RCE的问题。

• CamouflagedKiwi：对HTML设置带来的复杂生态系统表示担忧，认为浏览器需要对网页代码进行沙盒处理。尽管承认文章中提到的改进是好事情，但仍对潜在的权衡表示紧张。

• yanis_t：赞扬CSP在缓解安全问题和强制良好实践方面的作用，并分享了自己开发的CSP生成和验证工具链接。

• myfonj：惊讶于没有允许在初始载荷中设置内联事件处理器但禁用之后通过`setAttribute`设置的策略，认为这样可以保持静态表单功能并禁用恶意运行时模板。

• bbarnett：建议使用Firefox的配置文件功能来应对某些网站不兼容CSP的问题，并分享了自己在Linux上使用图标方便启动不同配置文件的经验。

• SebFender：认为CSP虽然有助于缓解一些安全问题，但通常可以通过简单的攻击绕过，尤其是在DOM管理和安全不佳的情况下。

• foobar9898989：以幽默的方式表达了对CSP在前端实现的看法，认为这是增加额外安全层的好事，但也提到浏览器安全进化的复杂性和挑战。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是CSP在实际应用中的有效性和浏览器厂商（如Mozilla）对其支持的及时性。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是对内联样式和脚本的不同看法，以及如何在不影响功能的情况下限制它们的使用。
• 还有对浏览器DevTools和界面安全问题的深层次担忧，尤其是在从XUL迁移后引入的新问题。

通过这些观点，可以看出CSP在实际应用中的复杂性和多面性，以及不同开发者和用户对其的不同期望和需求。

43630388.article_content:
Most of the Firefox User Interface (UI), including the address bar and the tab strip, are implemented using standard web technologies like HTML, CSS and JavaScript plus some additional custom components like
XUL
. One of the advantages of using web technologies for the front end is that it allows rendering the frontend using the browser engine on all desktop operating systems. However, just like many web applications are susceptible to some form of injection attack (
OWASP Top Ten
), Firefox’s use of web technologies for the frontend makes it no exception and hence it is vulnerable to injection attacks as well.
The most well known type of injection attack are Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. Like the name suggests, these attacks violate the boundary between different sites and circumvent first line security defenses like the
same-origin policy
. As with the existence of boundaries between different sites, the Firefox UI, which runs in the parent process, is separated from web content running in
lower-privileged content processes
. The sandboxed web content should not be able to inject content, especially code, into the parent process. Of course there needs to be some way for both parent and child processes to communicate with each other - otherwise it would, for example, be impossible to update a tab’s title in the UI after a web page sets its own document title. The way Firefox accomplishes this interaction is through a system called IPC -
inter-process communication
.
In Pwn2Own (a computer hacking contest) 2022 a participant managed to find a chain of exploits that allowed them to escape the web content sandbox (cf.
write-up by a ZDI employee
, a
generalized introduction
or
video by LifeOverflow
). A part of this exploit chain involved creating a JavaScript inline event handler (using setAttribute) in the Firefox UI, and then triggering the execution of that event handler. For websites, the well known approach of mitigating XSS attacks using inline event handlers usually involves using a
Content-Security-Policy
(CSP). CSP allows for restricting what scripts are allowed to execute on a given page. Typically by only allowing scripts from specific URLs, or with specific hashes. In particular, unless
‘unsafe-inline’
is specified, all attempts to define inline event handlers are blocked by the browser. And because the Firefox UI uses HTML with some special sauce, we can actually also use CSPs in the same way to harden the Firefox frontend code.
Progress
The main Firefox UI, which contains the tabs, address bar, menu bar etc. is actually just one big XHTML document called
browser.xhtml
. Recently we have removed in total over 600 inline event handlers across
50 bugs
from this XHTML document. At this point we want to acknowledge the support of the Firefox frontend team, without their co-operation we wouldn’t have been able to land so many changes in such a short amount of time.
Figure 1: Graph showing the number of inline event handlers in browser.xhtml over time in Firefox Nightly. The numbers were estimated using grep.
Interlude: How to replace inline event handlers
In case you are a Firefox developer, the maintainer of a Firefox fork like the Tor Browser, or just a web developer interested in securing your own website, the following might be relevant to you. The process of removing inline event handlers usually involves finding all the places that define an inline event handler like
<button onclick="buttonClicked()">
and then replacing this with a call to
addEventListener
from a new JS file. Roughly like this:
let
button
=
document
.
querySelector
(
"
button
"
);
button
.
addEventListener
(
"
click
"
,
buttonClicked
);
However there are some important differences to keep in mind between JS code running as inline event handlers and normal event handlers. Firstly, it’s possible to
return false;
from the inline event handler, which is equivalent to calling
event.preventDefault()
. Also note that
this
, which is
event.currentTarget
for inline event handlers, would change if you replaced it with an
arrow function
as the event listener.
Outlook
While browser.xhtml contains most parts of the main Firefox UI, some windows and sidebars are based on their own (X)HTML files. Due to the fact that browser.xhtml provides the largest attack vector of our frontend code we focused our initial efforts on securing and hardening browser.xhtml which already drastically improves the status quo to prevent inline script execution. For other windows, such as the “About Firefox” dialog, we go even further by adding CSPs that are much more restrictive and go beyond just blocking scripts. If you are familiar with CSP, by default we set a baseline CSP like
default-src chrome: resource:;
, which basically means we only allow loading resources from files that are shipped with Firefox.
Historically we have already added CSPs to
about:
pages such as
about:preferences
that are displayed like normal websites (cf.
Hardening Firefox against

主要讨论点：中美关税对贸易和消费者的影响，以及可能的规避措施和长期影响

不同观点：
• **关税对美国消费者的负面影响**：[testing22321] 认为关税将导致中国制造的商品在美国售价上升，同时美国出口到中国的商品也会更贵，从而减少销售，最终对美国消费者造成双重打击。

• **扩大关税范围的建议**：[londons_explore] 认为仅对商品征税不够，建议对服务、知识产权和外国企业也征税，例如对每观看一次美国电影征收税费，或者让麦当劳中国等外国企业支付额外税收。

• **规避关税的可能性**：[rcarr] 提出中国出口商可能通过在其他国家设立中介公司，以规避美国的进口关税，并轮换国家以应对可能的更高关税，质疑是否有措施防止这种行为。

• **关税的相互对等性**：[ZeroGravitas] 强调这些关税实际上是与中国对美国的关税对等的，并指出特朗普将其称为对等关税可能引发误解，需要澄清。

• **产业转移的可能性**：[nailer] 认为美国可能将从中国进口的产业（如iPhone制造）转移到印度等国，同时中国可能会将产品转向其他市场，并指出这些国家正在与美国走向全面自由贸易。

• **关税对欧洲的影响**：[DarkWiiPlayer] 希望中国转而购买更多欧洲商品，并推测中国最终可能通过自主生产来减少对外部市场的依赖。

补充讨论：
• 各方对关税的具体影响和实施细节存在不同看法，例如对消费者、企业以及国际贸易流动的影响。
• 有争议的焦点在于关税的实际效果和可能的规避策略，以及这些关税政策是否能达到预期目标。

China has pushed back again on U.S. President Donald Trump's tariff policies by hiking its levies on U.S. imports to more than 80%.
Tariffs on U.S. goods entering China will rise to 84% from 34% starting April 10, according to a translation of a Office of the Tariff Commission of the State Council
announcement
. The hike comes in response to the latest U.S. tariff increase on Chinese goods to more than 100% that began at midnight.
watch now
VIDEO
1:43
01:43
China announces retaliatory tariffs of 84% on U.S. goods in response to Trump
Squawk Box
The tit-for-tat escalation of tariffs threatens to crush trade between the world's two largest economies.  According to the
Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
, the U.S. exported $143.5 billion of goods to China in 2024, while importing products worth $438.9 billion.
The Trump administration announced a sweeping new tariff policy last week, and warned other countries not to retaliate. Some nations, including Japan, have seemed willing to negotiate on tariffs, but China appears to be taking a more hardline stance and quickly announced a countertariff.
After China's initial response to the April 2 tariff rollout, Trump announced an additional 50% hike, putting the total level for import taxes on Chinese goods at 104%.
"I think it's unfortunate that the Chinese actually don't want to come and negotiate, because they are the worst offenders in the international trading system," U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said to Fox Business on Wednesday after China's latest announcement. "They have the most imbalanced economy in the history of the modern world, and I can tell you that this escalation is a loser for them."
The U.S. had already imposed new tariffs on China before it rolled out its full trade policy in April. China, along with Canada and Mexico, was hit with new levies earlier in Trump's presidency as part of what the administration says was an effort to
stop fentanyl
from entering the U.S.
The trade war appears to have spooked investors around the world, as global equity markets have sold off sharply in April. The S&P 500 finished Tuesday down nearly 20% from its peak, putting the leading U.S. index of a bear market. South Korea's
Kospi Index dipped into a bear market

data.title: How to lock down your phone if you're traveling to the U.S.
data.author: sipofwater
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何在跨境时保护个人数字隐私，特别是在面对美国边境检查时应采取的措施。

不同观点：
• **提前备份并删除敏感信息**：kleiba认为，在入境前应该备份设备，删除可能被误解或被政府监控的敏感信息，如政治对话或联系人信息，以避免麻烦。

• **现代设备的数据主权问题**：jFriedensreich批评现代手机和应用程序对用户数据存储的控制，认为用户已经失去了对自己数据的主权，并接受了这种数字脆弱性。

• **设备清理与伪装策略**：miros_love指出，许多国家已经使用专门工具侵入手机并安装后门。他们建议清理设备并用无害的内容填充，以避免引起怀疑。

• **边境应对策略**：gruez认为，在边境检查时拒绝提供密码可能导致更严重的后果，如没收设备或拒绝入境，因此提前清理设备是更好的选择。

• **利用生物识别和密码的技巧**：incanus77提供了一个iPhone的使用技巧，通过组合按键使设备需要输入密码才能使用生物识别认证，增加了一层保护。

• **蜜罐密码设想**：pretzellogician提出是否可以设置一个次要密码，解锁后显示一个相对空的账户，以保护真实数据。

• **反对复杂防御措施**：BrandoElFollito认为复杂的防御措施是不必要的，普通人不应该试图像特工一样行事，而应保持常识。

• **对美国边境检查的反思**：senderista和cs702对美国边境检查的现状表示担忧，认为这与旅游目的地的吸引力相矛盾。

• **购买临时手机的建议**：MikeTheGreat和BriggyDwiggs42建议，可以考虑在跨境时购买一个临时手机，以避免带入敏感设备。

补充讨论：
• **历史对比与现实讽刺**：netsharc通过对比20世纪苏联边境检查的指南，讽刺现代2025年依然存在类似的数字隐私问题。

• **例外情况**：admiralrohan提到一个例外情况，去朝鲜旅行时并没有被检查手机。

争议焦点：是否应该采取复杂的设备保护措施，如清理设备或使用临时手机，以应对边境检查，还是应保持常识，避免引起边境官员的不满。

data.title: Quality-of-Life in Tetris Games
data.author: juancroldan
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同版本和变种的俄罗斯方块游戏设计及其规则差异

不同观点：
• jchw认为Tetris the Grand Master (TGM) 系列的设计比"guideline"或NES Tetris规则更优雅。他指出TGM的旋转和踢墙规则更简洁，而guideline Tetris的踢墙规则过于复杂且允许一些不合理的操作（如T-Spin Triple）。他还提到TGM的随机生成算法较简单且更具挑战性，而7-bag算法生成块的顺序过于规律，降低了游戏的难度和趣味性。

• downsplat回忆早期DOS版本的俄罗斯方块，并提到他编写的各种变体，包括完全随机生成块的版本和一个总是给出最难块的版本。他更倾向于早期版本的随机性，而非现代的简化随机算法。

• qsort提供了现代Tetris游戏的旋转系统规范链接，并指出"guideline"规则（包括Hold、7-bag、多个预览和易于T-spin的旋转系统）使得多人游戏更加有趣，而不仅是谁能最快地堆叠Tetrises。

• throw10920支持墙踢机制的灵活性，认为当用户尝试进行不允许的操作时，系统应尽量提供接近的有用操作，而不是严格遵守操作语义。

• curiouser3提到Apotris（GBA上的Tetris变体）通过各种设置调整控制和灵敏度，使得游戏体验更加出色。

• jstanley质疑在没有长条块的情况下玩100块的可能性，认为这可能是由于其他bug引起的。

• franze分享了自己制作的非Tetris克隆游戏，并表示仍在研究和改进旋转系统。

• zabzonk回忆早期通过调试器修改游戏的经历，包括去除拷贝保护和添加鼠标支持。

• amichail提到他正在开发的游戏DropZap World，结合了Tetris和Candy Crush的元素，并寻求反馈。

• iNic指出在快速游戏环境中，玩家更喜欢"real"旋转系统而非"NES"旋转系统，因为前者允许用更少的按键放置块。

• isolli询问如何向他的儿子介绍Tetris，并寻找适合的当前游戏版本。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及多个技术细节，如随机生成算法（7-bag、TGM随机算法）、墙踢机制和旋转系统（SRS）。
• 不同玩家对游戏规则和设计的偏好反映了个人经历和对游戏挑战性的不同期望。
• 争议的焦点在于哪种规则和设计更优越，特别是TGM与guideline Tetris之间的比较。
• 一些评论提到了对早期游戏版本的情感和技术修改，显示了对经典游戏的怀旧和持续探索。

data.title: Ironwood: The first Google TPU for the age of inference
data.author: meetpateltech
data.article_summary: Google发布了第七代张量处理单元（TPU）——Ironwood，专为推理（inference）设计，是迄今为止最强大、高效的TPU。Ironwood可扩展至9,216个芯片，提供42.5 Exaflops的计算能力，比世界上最强的超级计算机还强大24倍。它配备增强的SparseCore、更大的HBM容量和带宽，以及改进的ICI网络，支持大规模的推理AI模型，如大型语言模型和专家混合模型。Ironwood是Google Cloud AI超算架构的一部分，优化了硬件和软件以应对高要求的AI工作负载，帮助开发者高效处理复杂任务。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Google TPU（张量处理单元）的发布及其影响，包括技术细节、市场竞争、应用场景和可获得性。

不同观点：
• 一些评论质疑TPU是否真的是第一个专门为推理设计的芯片，提到最初的TPU似乎仅用于推理。[nharada]
• 有人对TPU仅存在于云端且难以实际获得表示失望，认为这种硬件的发布缺乏实际意义。[throwaway48476]
• 有人对芯片领域的竞争表示欢迎，认为Google的TPU为Nvidia在机器学习硬件市场上的主导地位带来了挑战。[no_wizard]
• 有人关心这种专用芯片是否会为Google在提供大语言模型服务时带来显著的成本优势，并询问竞争对手是否也能获得类似技术。[nehalem]
• 有人对TPU在架构层面的效率提升来源感兴趣，询问是否依赖于少数大的改进还是许多小的改进。[_hark]
• 有人关注TPU的API支持情况，包括驱动是否已整合进Linux、是否有特定API以及在Google Cloud上的实例如何使用。[tuna74]
• 有评论批评Google在基准测试对比中使用误导性数据，认为不应在不支持fp8的架构之间进行不公平对比，并呼吁更诚实的性能表述。[fancyfredbot]

Today at Google Cloud Next 25, we’re introducing Ironwood, our seventh-generation Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) — our most performant and scalable custom AI accelerator to date, and the first designed specifically for inference. For more than a decade, TPUs have powered Google’s most demanding AI training and serving workloads, and have enabled our Cloud customers to do the same. Ironwood is our most powerful, capable and energy efficient TPU yet. And it's purpose-built to power thinking, inferential AI models at scale.
Ironwood represents a significant shift in the development of AI and the infrastructure that powers its progress. It’s a move from
responsive
AI models that provide real-time information for people to interpret, to models that provide the
proactive
generation of insights and interpretation. This is what we call the “age of inference” where AI agents will proactively retrieve and generate data to collaboratively deliver insights and answers, not just data.
Ironwood is built to support this next phase of generative AI and its tremendous computational and communication requirements. It scales up to 9,216 liquid cooled chips linked with breakthrough Inter-Chip Interconnect (ICI) networking spanning nearly 10 MW. It is one of several new components of
Google Cloud AI Hypercomputer
architecture, which optimizes hardware and software together for the most demanding AI workloads. With Ironwood, developers can also leverage Google’s own
Pathways
software stack to reliably and easily harness the combined computing power of tens of thousands of Ironwood TPUs.
Here’s a closer look at how these innovations work together to take on the most demanding training and serving workloads with unparalleled performance, cost and power efficiency.
Powering the age of inference with Ironwood
Ironwood is designed to gracefully manage the complex computation and communication demands of "thinking models," which encompass Large Language Models (LLMs), Mixture of Experts (MoEs) and advanced reasoning tasks. These models require massive parallel processing and efficient memory access. In particular, Ironwood is designed to minimize data movement and latency on chip while carrying out massive tensor manipulations. At the frontier, the computation demands of thinking models extend well beyond the capacity of any single chip. We designed Ironwood TPUs with a low-latency, high bandwidth ICI network to support coordinated, synchronous communication at full TPU pod scale.
For Google Cloud customers, Ironwood comes in two sizes based on AI workload demands: a 256 chip configuration and a 9,216 chip configuration.

data.article_summary:
文章作者反思了三篇Stratechery上的文章，认为它们在不同方面存在不足。首先，作者讨论了周一发布的关于贸易、关税和科技的文章，认为其缺乏整体框架和令人满意的结论。其次，作者回顾了2023年11月的一篇文章，指出其对特朗普贸易政策的影响预测虽然准确，但表达不够明确。第三篇文章是2021年1月关于互联网3.0和科技历史开端的文章，作者承认其对科技时代转变的预测过早，且误判了转变原因，实际上是美国对世界关闭了大门。

文章进一步探讨了美国制造业的 disruptive（颠覆性）变化，引用克莱顿·克里斯坦森的“颠覆性创新”理论，描述了小公司如何通过满足被忽视的市场需求成功挑战大公司。作者以半导体行业为例，说明制造过程中的低利润环节被外包到亚洲，而创新和利润仍留在美国。然而，随着时间推移，美国在这些关键制造领域的优势逐渐丧失，导致了当前的问题。作者认为，这种 disruptive 过程正是美国制造业面临的核心挑战。

I have a few informal guidelines that govern my writing on Stratechery, including “Don’t post more than one front-page Article a week”, “Don’t talk about my writing process”, and “Don’t start Articles with ‘I’”; it’s an extraordinary week, though, so I’m breaking a few rules.
There are three old Stratechery Articles that, after reflection, missed the mark in different ways.
The most proximate cause for my rule-breaking was Monday’s
Trade, Tariffs, and Tech
; I stand by everything I wrote, but it was incomplete, lacking an overall framework and satisfying conclusion. That’s not surprising given the current uncertainty, but that means I should have waited to publish a front-page Article until I had more clarity (I do much more musing in my Updates, which that Article is now categorized as). Now I have to break my rule and write another Article.
The second Article to revisit is November’s
A Chance to Build
. This Article was in fact deeply pessimistic about President Trump’s promised trade regime, particularly in terms of what it meant for tech; the title and conclusion, however, tried to find some positives. Clearly that was a mistake; that Article was predictive of what was happening, but I obscured the prediction.
The third Article to revisit is January 2021’s
Internet 3.0 and the Beginning of (Tech) History
. This Article was right about tech exiting an economically-defined era — the Aggregation era — and entering a new politically-defined era. It was, however, four years too early, and misdiagnosed the reason for the transition. The driver is not foreign countries closing their doors to America; it’s America closing its door to the world.
The proximate cause of all of this reflection is of course Trump’s disastrous “liberation day” tariffs. The secondary cause is what I wrote about Monday: the U.S. has a genuine problem on its hands thanks to its inability to make things pertinent to modern warfare and high tech. The root cause, however, is very much in Stratechery’s wheelhouse, and worthy of another Article: it’s disruption.
The Disruption of American Manufacturing
The late Professor Clayton Christensen —
one of my personal heroes and inspirations
— coined the term disruption in a seminal paper called
Disruptive Technologies: Catching the Wave
, which he expanded to book-length in
The Innovator’s Dilemma
. However, Christensen’s most concise summary comes from
this 20-year retrospective in Harvard Business Review
:
“Disruption” describes a process whereby a smaller company with fewer resources is able to successfully challenge established incumbent businesses. Specifically, as incumbents focus on improving their products and services for their most demanding (and usually most profitable) customers, they exceed the needs of some segments and ignore the needs of others. Entrants that prove disruptive begin by successfully targeting those overlooked segments, gaining a foothold by delivering more-suitable functionality—frequently at a lower price. Incumbents, chasing higher profitability in more-demanding segments, tend not to respond vigorously. Entrants then move upmarket, delivering the performance that incumbents’ mainstream customers require, while preserving the advantages that drove their early success. When mainstream customers start adopting the entrants’ offerings in volume, disruption has occurred.
This is almost a perfect summary of what has happened in manufacturing, and, as I noted
in that November article
, it started with chips:
That history starts in 1956, when William Shockley founded the Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory to commercialize the transistor that he had helped invent at Bell Labs; he chose Mountain View to be close to his ailing mother. A year later the so-called “Traitorous Eight”, led by Robert Noyce, left and founded Fairchild Semiconductor down the road. Six years after that Fairchild Semiconductor opened a facility in Hong Kong to assemble and test semiconductors. Assembly required manually attaching wires to a semiconductor chip, a labor-intensive and monotonous task that was difficult to do economically with American wages, which ran about $2.50/hour; Hong Kong wages were a tenth of that. Four years later Texas Instruments opened a facility in Taiwan, where wages were $0.19/hour; two years after that Fairchild Semiconductor opened another facility in Singapore, where wages were $0.11/hour.
In other words, you can make the case that the classic story of Silicon Valley isn’t completely honest. Chips did have marginal costs, but that marginal cost was, within single digit years of the founding of Silicon Valley, exported to Asia.
Notice what did still happen in the United States, at least back then: actual chip fabrication.

data.title: The chroot Technique – a Swiss army multitool for Linux systems
data.author: mariuz
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了在Linux系统中使用**chroot**技术来修复无法启动的系统，特别是通过从Live USB启动并挂载故障系统的硬盘来诊断和修复问题。具体步骤包括：

1. 启动替代操作系统（如Live USB）。
2. 确定故障系统硬盘的分区（如根目录`/`和`/boot`）。
3. 创建用于挂载的文件夹，如`/rescue`和`/rescue/boot`。
